name: Target Lock
description: The next hit on this target cannot miss.

name: Suppress
description: Covering fire. Everyone hit loses a thread next turn.

name: Fracture
description: A crack in the timeline. Raises the party's Entropy.

name: Amend
description: A correction to the record: an ally's wound is amended away.

name: Minute
description: An ally is entered into the minutes, and hits 15% harder for it.

name: Stand Between
description: Steps in front. For two turns every single hit the party throws lands on it instead, at full strength.

name: Strike the Record
description: A blow that also strikes 4 Tempo from the party's record.

name: Seize the Minutes
description: Takes whatever the target is carrying: Litany, Guard, Anchor, all of it, and wears it instead.

name: Wind Up
description: Next turn it unleashes a heavy blow. Bound by terms or Target Lock breaks the wind-up.

name: Heavy Blow
description: The wound-up blow. It lands hard enough to matter.

name: Spool
description: Next turn it discharges a lance of heat. Bound by terms or Target Lock breaks the spool.

name: Lance
description: The spooled discharge. Thermal, and it goes through shields.
